questions.text: What is the percentage of males died in total number of persons died due to COVID - 19?
questions.explanation:
Calculation:

Number of males died = (35/100 × 1/2 + 5/100 × 1/5 + 20/100 × 2/5 + 40/100 × 4/5) × 200000 = 1,17,000

Total number of persons died = 2,00,000

Required percentage = (1,17,000/2,00,000) × 100

⇒ 58.5%

∴ The percentage of males died in total number of persons died due to COVID - 19 is 58.5%

questions.text: Apples sold by vendors A and B in monsoon is approximately what % more than the apples sold by vendors C and D in summer?
questions.explanation:
Calculation:

Apples sold by vendors A and B in monsoon = (300 + 400)

⇒ 700

Apples sold by vendors C and D = (240 + 250)

⇒ 490

Required percentage = [(700 – 490)/490] × 100

⇒ [210 / 490] × 100

⇒ 42.85% ≈ 43%

∴ The required percentage is 43%

questions.text:
In each of the following number series, the wrong number is given, find out that number.

1, 6, 21, 65, 201, 606, 1821
questions.explanation:
Given:

1, 6, 21, 65, 201, 606, 1821

Calculation:

The series follows the following pattern

1 × 3 + 3 = 6

6 × 3 + 3 = 21

21 × 3 + 3 = 66 ≠ 65

66 × 3 + 3 = 201

201 × 3 + 3 = 606

606 × 3 + 3 = 1821

∴ 65 is wrong and should be replaced by 66

(27 + 43) – 1 = 69

questions.text: The side of a cube is 50% more than the radius of a cylinder. If the curved surface area of the cylinder is 1408 cm<sup>2</sup> and its height is 350% of its radius, then find the ratio between the numerical value of volume and the surface area of the cube.
questions.explanation:
GIVEN :

The side of a cube is 50% more than the radius of a cylinder.

If the curved surface area of the cylinder is 1408 cm2 

Its height is 350% of its radius.

ASSUMPTION :

Let the radius of the cylinder (r) = a

So, the height of the cylinder (h) = a × 350/100 = 7a/2

FORMULA USED :

Curved surface area of the cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

CALCULATION :

According to the question :

⇒ 2πrh = 1408

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × a × (7a/2) = 1408

⇒ 22a2 = 1408

⇒ a2 = 64

⇒ a = 8

The side of the cube = 8 × 150/100 = 12 cm

So, the volume of the cube = 12 × 12 × 12 cm3

And the whole surface area of the cube = 6 × 12 × 12 cm2

∴ Required ratio = (12 × 12 × 12) : (6 × 12 × 12) = 2 : 1

questions.text: ABC private limited purchased a square plot of land for Rs.5120000  at the rate of Rs.800 sq.m. What is the time in which the man will complete running 3 laps along the sides of the plot when is man is moving with a speed of 14.4 kmph?
questions.explanation:
Given:

A square plot of land purchased for = Rs. 5120000

Rate per square meter of land  = Rs. 800

Speed of the man = 14.4 kmph = 14.4 x (5/18) = 4 m/s.

Concept used:

Area of land = Total money for land / Rate per square meter

Calculation:

Area of square plot = 5120000/800

a2  =   6400

a = 80m

Now, the side of the square plot = 80m

So the length of 1 lap = 4 x 80 = 320m

So the length of 3 laps = 320 x  3 = 960m.

So the time in which 960m is covered = 960/4 = 240 seconds = 4 minutes.

Hence, the time in which 3 laps are covered is 4 minutes.

questions.text: A boat covers a distance of 32 km in water flow. The initial speed of the boat in downstream 1 km/hr. But due to a wave after every 2 hours, his speed increases by 2 km/hr, and on his return, his speed becomes 1/2 of his average speed of downstream and no wave is there in return. To find the average speed of his entire journey. (Approximately).
questions.explanation:
Given:

A boat covers a distance of 32 km in water flow.

Due to a wave after every 2 hours his speed increases by 2 km/hr.

On his return, his speed becomes 1/2 of his average speed of downstream.

The initial speed of the boat in downstream 1 km/hr.

Concept:

The direction along the stream is called downstream.

The direction against the stream is called upstream.

Formula used:

Distance = speed × time

Average speed = total distance/total time

Calculation:

The initial speed of the boat in downstream 1 km/hr.

Due to a wave after every 2 hours his speed increases by 2 km/hr.

Distance covered by boat in first 2 hours

⇒ Speed × time

⇒ 1 × 2 = 2 km

Now his speed increase by 2 km/hr

Speed = 1 + 2 = 3 km/hr

Distance covered by boat in next 2 hours

⇒ 2 × 3 = 6 km

Similarly in next 2 hour

⇒ 2 × 5 = 10 km

Similarly in next 2 hour

⇒ 2 × 7 = 14 km

Now the total distance that he covered

⇒ 2 + 6 + 10 + 14 = 32 km

Total time taken by boat to cover distance

⇒ 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 8 hours

Now the average speed of boat in downstream

⇒ Total distance/total time

⇒ 32/8 = 4 km/hr

On his return his speed becomes 1/2 of the earlier speed

So upstream speed of boat is

⇒ 4 × (1/2) = 2 km/hr

Time taken by boat in upstream to cover distance

⇒ Total distance/speed

⇒ 32/2 = 16 hours

Thus the average speed of his entire journey

⇒ Total distance/total time

⇒ (32 + 32)/(8 + 16)

⇒ 64/24 = 2.67 km/hr

∴ The average speed of his entire journey is 2.67 km/hr.

questions.text: A tub contains 15 black balls and 10 white balls out of which 4 black balls and 2 white balls are defective. If a person takes two balls at random, what is the probability that either both are black balls or both are good balls?
questions.explanation:
Given:

A tub contains 15 black balls and 10 white balls out of which 4 black balls and 2 white balls are defective

Concept used:

The classical definition of probability.

Formula used:

Probability = Favorable Outcome/Total Outcome.

P(E) = n(E)/n(S)

Calculation:

Number of ways in which two balls can be taken from 25 balls = 25C2 

Number of ways in which two black balls can be taken from 15 black balls = 15C2 

P(both are black balls) = 15C2/25C2

Number of ways in which two balls can be taken from 19 good balls = 19C2 

Total good balls = (15 + 10) - (4 + 2) = 19

P(both are good) = 19C2/25C2

There are 11 good black balls. Number of ways in which two black balls can be taken from these 11 good black balls = 11C2

P(both are black balls and both are good) = 11C2/25C2

P(both are black balls or both are good) = P(both are black balls) + P(both are good) – P(both are black balls and both are good)

(15C2/25C2) + (19C2/25C2) − (11C2/25C2)

⇒ (15C2 + 19C2 – 11C2)/25C2

⇒ [{(15 × 14)/(2 × 1)} + {(19 × 18)/(2 × 1)} – {(11 × 10)/(2 × 1)}]/[{(25 × 24)/(2 × 1)}]

= 221/300

questions.text: The speed of a boat in still water is 8 km/h and the speed of a stream is 1.5 km/h. A man rows to a place at a distance of 61.75 km and comes back to the starting point. What is the total time taken by him?
questions.explanation:
Given:

Speed of stream = 1.5 km/h

Speed of a boat in still water = 8 km/h

Distance = 61.75 km

Calculations:

⇒ Rate Upstream = 8 – 1.5 = 6.5 km/h

⇒ Rate Downstream = 8 + 1.5 = 9.5 km/h

⇒ Time take to go upstream = 61.75/6.5 = 9.5 h

⇒ Time take to go downstream = 61.75/9.5 = 6.5 h

⇒ Total time = 9.5 + 6.5 = 16 h

Total time taken by the man is 16 hours.
